title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Yawa Bridge, in the Municipality of Legaspi, Province of Albay, to Antonio De Las Alas Bridge.

text.en:
The bridge called Yawa Bridge, on the river of the same name in the municipality of Legaspi,
Province of Albay shall hereafter be called Antonio de las Alas Bridge.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 2, 1935.
